name: Log All Tool Calls
description: Logs every Claude tool invocation to a file for auditing and debugging purposes
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Log all tool calls to a file
LOG_DIR="$HOME/.claude/logs"
mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"
LOG_FILE="$LOG_DIR/tool-calls-$(date +%Y-%m-%d).log"
TIMESTAMP=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
echo "[$TIMESTAMP] Tool: $TOOL_NAME | Input: $TOOL_INPUT" >> "$LOG_FILE"
exit 0
